operator_quote: Okay, until I actually start getting into this, I need uh, her to just start throwing shit on my calendar and signing me up for stuff.

command.text: Yes, sign him up with his name, but use openrangeinteractive@gmail.com, the job-hunt inbox she already watches, so confirmations and calendar invites land where she reads them. Phone: the signup phone (his Google Voice number), never his real one, and leave it blank if the form allows. Resume: the newest resume in Documents\Aletheia, only when an event asks for one.
